name: Enterprise Data Landscape and Analytical Lineage View
constraints: Data Landscape is a governed version-pinned projection and Analytical Lineage View narrows WM-DAT-006 to metric-report-analysis-claim paths; neither mints subject identity.
Catalog records, products, datasets, schemas, pipelines, runs, lineage, metrics, observations, reports, studies and claims retain separate mastership.
Definition and execution or release identities remain distinct and released definitions and executions are immutable.
Every lineage edge records dependency type, transformation subtype, masking, granularity, capture method, producer or schema version, confidence and evidence.
Name similarity, temporal adjacency and co-occurrence never prove direct derivation.
Comparability reconciles formula, unit, population, dimensions, additivity and null policy; identical KPI titles are insufficient.
Missing edges imply absence only within a closed versioned completeness perimeter.
Views inherit source rights, mark withheld segments explicitly and never execute enforcement.
holds: Metric Definition remains identifier-unassigned under EM-DAT-05.
WM-REC-002 publication completion, WM-DAT-006 perimeter semantics and source-version divergences require reconciliation.
Independent Grok review, source pins and frozen audit remain pending.
